confidence_notes: Numbeo’s 2 October 2026 snapshot reports La Spezia meal, cappuccino and draft-beer prices, but notes some estimates come from a small pool of 14 contributors; this snapshot postdates the July reference window. Cocktail and restaurant wine-glass prices were not directly available, so I estimated them at about 1.8× and 1× the local draft-beer price. Hostel averages cover four properties, and the hotel source gives seasonal budget and mid-range prices before taxes and fees, making the lodging estimates less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; direct La Spezia price data was available.
